app.title: ABDO Creator OS
app.tagline: An AI-powered operating system for content creators.

home.title: Welcome to ABDO Creator OS
home.subtitle: Research, write, plan, and ship — with a coordinated team of AI agents.
home.stepProviders: 1. Add a provider API key in Providers & Models.
home.stepAssistant: 2. Open the AI Assistant and send your first prompt.
home.stepSkills: 3. Browse built-in Skills or create your own.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Send a prompt to your configured provider. The Advocate role returns a structured proposal.
assistant.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Outline a 5-minute YouTube video about sustainable home office setups.
assistant.roleGuidancePlaceholder: e.g. Focus on B2B SaaS founders, professional tone.
assistant.noProviderBody: Add an OpenAI-compatible API key in Providers & Models to start chatting.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Your work, organized.
projects.emptyHint: Create your first project to organize your scripts, research, and conversations.

providers.title: Providers & Models
providers.subtitle: Bring your own API key. We support any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, plus first-class adapters for specific providers as they're added.
providers.noProviders: You haven't added a provider yet.
providers.configUses: Will be used for chat requests when selected or as default.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Reusable, versioned, declarative capabilities. Built-in Skills are seeded; you can add your own.
skills.deleteSkillConfirm: Delete this skill? This cannot be undone.

research.title: Research
research.subtitle: Gather sources, organize claims, and fact-check your work.
research.sourcesLabel: Sources (one per line: URL | Title | Reliability)
research.liveSearchUnavailable: Live web search is a Phase 3 feature. You can still create reports by supplying sources and claims here.

scripts.title: Script Studio
scripts.subtitle: Develop, revise, and repurpose scripts.
scripts.tip: Tip: ask the AI Assistant to review a hook, then paste the feedback here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account, preferences, and memories.
settings.memoryHint: Add a fact you'd like the OS to remember across sessions. Examples: your timezone, your house style, your audience.
settings.preferencesHint: Stored as JSON. Used to bias agent behavior. Won't override your explicit instructions for a task.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Recorded call counts. Token counts are reported by the provider when available; otherwise shown as unknown.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Run a coordinated 5-agent workflow. Each agent's structured output becomes the next agent's input. The final Reviewer's output is the deliverable.
workflows.classFull: Full — Advocate → Critic → Synthesizer → Business Analyst → Reviewer

tools.title: Content tools
tools.subtitle: Distinct workflows for idea development, summarization, rewriting, SEO outlines, audience analysis, repurposing, and YouTube outlines. Each is a real tool — not a renamed generic prompt.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Submit your own Skills for moderation. Published Skills are visible to all users; private data is never exposed through community.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Read the documentation, or ask the help assistant.
help.assistantScope: The help assistant is strictly scoped to the documentation catalog below. It does not have access to your projects, conversations, provider keys, or any other user data.
